info.title: Podlight server
info.description: Gateway for agents (/v1, client tokens) and control API for Podlight apps (/admin, device tokens from pairing). Plain HTTP; run it behind a reverse proxy with TLS.

client.description: Client token (pl-…) created in the app.

clientApiKey.name: x-api-key
clientApiKey.description: Client token, as Claude Code sends ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

PodTelemetry.description: One sample of what a pod is doing, measured by its watchdog. `time` is Unix seconds; a missing source leaves out its fields.

telemetry.description: The latest sample per model whose pod runs, keyed by model id.

balance.description: The RunPod account, at most about a minute old; null until first read or without a key.

usd.description: Credit left in the RunPod account.

spendPerHourUsd.description: What everything in the account costs per hour now, by RunPod.

spendLimitUsd.description: RunPod's own spend limit for the account.

token.description: Only in the answer to POST /admin/client-tokens.

get.summary: Liveness, version, whether any app is paired

post.summary: Exchange the pairing code from the log for a device token

get.summary: Models this key may use (OpenAI and Anthropic fields)

post.summary: OpenAI API, passed to the engine
post.description: The `model` field picks the model. A stopped model is woken (spend limits are checked first) and the request held until it answers. Request and response are passed through unchanged, streaming included; on /v1/messages, `role: "system"` entries inside `messages` become user text in `<system-reminder>`.

get.summary: Everything the app shows: models, runs, settings, spend

post.summary: Compare the stored pods with RunPod now and let go of deleted ones

patch.summary: Change settings; secrets are write-only, "" removes one

post.summary: Check a RunPod key (the given one, or the stored one)

get.summary: RunPod's GPU catalog with availability, through the server's key

delete.summary: Remove a model, deleting its pod and disk

post.summary: Take a model over from a Mac with its pod and the pod's key; the pod is renamed to a server pod, nothing is downloaded again
Start until a time ("Läuft bis"); without one, idle stop ends it

newPod.description: Delete a stopped pod with its disk and build a new one (when its machine has no free card).

maxPricePerHour.description: The user approved a pricier card: cards up to this price per hour (whole pod) may be booked. Without it, a fallback may cost at most fallbackPriceStepPercent more than the chosen card; above that the start answers 503 card_too_expensive and the run waits for a card within the price.

post.summary: Stop (kept disk) or delete the pod

get.summary: What the pod has been doing in the last 30 minutes, oldest first

post.summary: Create an access key, optionally limited to models; the key is shown once

patch.summary: Rename or change the models of an access key

post.summary: A new pairing code for another device
